intro.background: 教玩具展会：GESS Dubai（迪拜幼教展）、育蕴幼教展、广交会、Canton Fair。展会接待要点：主动招呼、问国家/项目、递名片、加WhatsApp、发资料。不要一上来就报价。
intro.desc: 掌握展会接待的英语表达。

oneLiner.en: At an exhibition, every visitor is a potential project — your greeting decides whether they stop at your booth.
oneLiner.cn: 展会上每个参观者都是潜在项目——你的招呼决定他会不会停在你展位。

vocab.ex: We are exhibiting at GESS Dubai.
May I have your business card?
Do you have any upcoming projects?
I will follow up after the show.

mistakes.right: Welcome to our booth! We specialize in kindergarten furniture. Which country are you from?
mistakes.cn: 错误：展会硬推销。要热情招呼+问需求。

basic.en: I will follow up after the show.

advanced.en: Welcome to our booth! We specialize in custom kindergarten furniture and outdoor playground equipment. Which country are you from, and do you have any upcoming projects?
advanced.cn: 欢迎来到我们展位！我们专注定制幼儿园家具和户外游乐设备。您来自哪个国家？有upcoming项目吗？

advanced.en: Let me give you our brochure and add your WhatsApp — I will send our European project portfolio tonight and schedule a call next week.
advanced.cn: 我给您宣传册，加您WhatsApp——今晚发欧洲项目案例集，下周约电话。

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Welcome! We are a Wenzhou manufacturer specializing in kindergarten furniture and outdoor playgrounds. Which country are you from?
lines.cn: 欢迎！我们是温州厂家，专注幼儿园家具和户外游乐。您来自哪个国家？

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: We are from Saudi Arabia. We are looking for a supplier.
lines.cn: 我们来自沙特。在找供应商。

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Great! Here is our brochure. Can I add your WhatsApp? I will send our Middle East project references tonight.
lines.cn: 太好了！这是宣传册。我能加您WhatsApp吗？今晚发中东项目参考给您。

fillBlank.q: I will ____ up after the show.

scenario.q: A visitor stops at your booth. How do you greet them?
scenario.modelAnswer: Welcome to our booth! We specialize in custom kindergarten furniture and outdoor playground equipment, with projects in over 50 countries. Which country are you from, and do you have any upcoming projects? Let me give you our brochure and add your WhatsApp — I will follow up after the show.
scenario.cn: 欢迎来到我们展位！我们专注定制幼儿园家具和户外游乐，50多国项目。您来自哪个国家？有upcoming项目吗？给您宣传册，加您WhatsApp——展后跟进。

culture.title: 展会的黄金30秒
culture.content: 展位人流大，每个客户只给你30秒。流程：1秒微笑招呼→5秒定位（我们是温州XX厂）→5秒问国家+项目→10秒给亮点→递名片加WhatsApp→1秒道别。不要纠缠，让他留下资料比聊10分钟有用。
